preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(m, int) and 1 <= n <= 200000 and n - 1 <= m <= 200000
preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are integers within the specified bounds, and the graph is connected (m >= n-1).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(u, int) and isinstance(v, int) and isinstance(w, int) and 1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge consists of two distinct vertices within the range [1, n] and a positive integer weight up to 10^9.
The number of edges provided matches m.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(u, v), max(u, v)) for u, v, w in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: The graph contains no multiple edges between the same pair of vertices.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output_str, str) and output_str.strip().isdigit() and int(output_str.strip()) >= 0
postconditions.description: The output is a single non-negative integer string.
The output integer equals the minimum number of weight increment operations required to make the MST unique while preserving the original MST cost.
